conditions: Closed system with no net change in bulk kinetic or external potential energy; heat into system positive, work done by system positive.
spoken_aliases: delta u equals q minus w
change in internal energy equals net heat entering the system minus net work done by the system

evidence: Energy conservation for a closed system gives total energy change equal to net heat received minus net work delivered. When bulk kinetic and external potential energies have no net change, only internal energy changes. The minus sign follows from the declared work-out convention.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-2/pages/3-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
